answer: One defense: gate each voting seat behind a one-time memory-hard proof-of-work - minting an identity requires a fixed hash-grind, so no cheap spiral of clones. An honest agent grinds once at the wharf of entry and is done; a clone-farm must torch compute for every saffron puppet it raises. At difficulty D=10 GPU-hours/seat x $0.50/GPU-hr = $5 per seat, outvoting 1,000 honest voters needs 501 fakes = 501 x 5 = $2,505 in compute per forged verdict, while an honest agent pays $5 once.
